title: Phases in the cyclic quantum dilogarithm: correction to "Cyclic quantum Teichmüller theory"
summary: We first correct $\boldsymbolμ_N$-phase issues in the basic definition around the cyclic quantum dilogarithm operators in [Ish26]. In particular, the notion of global coefficients must be extended by incorporating additional lifting data forming a $\boldsymbolμ_N$-cover, and the pentagon relation generally acquires an extra $\boldsymbolμ_N$-factor. Nevertheless, we prove that every point in a regular locus of the partially compactified cluster Poisson variety lifts to a \emph{strict} extended global coefficient, for which this extra $\boldsymbolμ_N$-factor is trivial.
